title: 第两千三百九十七章 谢瑜的构想第两千三百九十六章 我们运行机制的秘籍－2
content_zh:
上到大坝，在蓝色小屋位置下了车，我说：“休息一会儿嘛！”
“你看！”眼镜女看着蓝色小屋旁边树林里隐隐出现的小木屋，“那里好像有人呢！要不我们去看看？”这还真的是认真考察了。
“走呗！”我说，“龙凤哥，今天你没带她们来过吗？”
“嘿嘿，走马观花嘛！”龙凤哥说，“其实这有啥好看的？”
“看看，看看！”谢瑜倒也不不客气，直接走了过去，“你看看这客人，来度假村了，也不忘记工作，手提那是敲得飞快！”
我就笑了：“那是我们的程序员！苏元日，我们都叫他元旦！”然后我小声告诉谢瑜，“这小子，给袁大头的侄女看上啦！”
“你说袁圆？！”谢瑜愣了一下，“嘿，厉害！对了，你们的程序员，怎么自己一个人在这小树林办公啊？还是一房一厅的小木屋？有点想不通啊！”
“来来来，苏元旦！”我招呼这苏元日过来，“见过谢行！”
“谢行？”苏元日说，“谢行，你好！我叫苏元日，她们都叫我元旦，元日，也不知道谁老眼昏花，将日字看错了一横，变成元旦啦！我在这里办公啊！您觉得奇怪是吧？我来公司时候，林总说愿意在哪里办公就在哪里办公，我又不愿意在办公室，所以就跑这儿来咯！这个位置，满足了我整天可以对着绿水青山办公的愿望。我可不是不合群啊，我就是做事时候喜欢一个人而已啦！平时没事干的时候，我到处溜达的。”
“嘿，还真行啊！”谢瑜说，“那你忙你的去吧！”她转过来对我说，“你还真的这样玩啊！”
“why
no？”我说，“团伙成员个个都有个性，随他们呗！只要完成工作，其他的，我管？我不累啊？那多没意思啊！我现在不用管，革命靠自觉，不也很好的效果吗？”
谢瑜说：“哎，和你说个事儿！”她靠了过来，“我俩边走边说。”
我反应过来：“龙凤哥，你带她们坐小火车过去，或者踩双人单车过去啊！我和谢瑜走走。”
等她们都走开了，我和谢瑜两人走在大坝上。
“今天和赖永昌谈过了。”谢瑜说。
“顺利不？”我问。
谢瑜笑笑：“过场而已了。他欠我们银行的贷款，现在请他从香港回来，很给面子了。”
“面子？谁给谁？”我问。
她看看我：“你的理解能力是不是故意的啊！”

“哈哈哈！故意的，故意的。”我问，“我确实是想买下铜钱岭。”我心里暗自承认我说这句话的时候，是没有估计到和紫萱沟通时候她的立场，而且这样做，确实要冒一定的风险，这风险，也许在银行的干预下其实已经消失了，也许在银行在干预下反而冒出来私人借贷那一方面的风险呢？谁也说不准。但是我就是想，一是位置，我很喜欢那种站在前排看风景的感觉，而铜钱岭的就是这样；二是我看好银海湾，在现有我们的强势下我愿意加码银海湾，想玩成类似垄断，应该说是亚垄断那种状态；我一直没忘记那个梦，化身张保仔的手下登上铜钱岭在某个位置埋下了两箱财宝，如果不是我在水库之下找到过那几支簪，我就不会有这样的执念。虽然我到现在还是觉得有点荒诞感，说出去给谁听，除了老胖啊，龙凤哥和可可之外，其他人肯定觉得我是不是脑子有点问题了，---这不奇怪，现在个个都是无神论者，但又个个都想上天眷顾自己，都是矛盾着，站在不同的立场时候，此时觉得矛比盾利，彼时又觉得盾比矛硬。
“你有这样的想法吗？”谢瑜看着我，“好啊！”
“嘿，都知己知彼了。”我说，“你就直说吧！”
“你得先告诉我你的资金来源啊！”谢瑜说，“我这里也不是随便就可以贷款的，何况我们是老同学，更要讲规则了。讲规则，你好我好大家好。对着老同学，我才这么直白的说了啊！”
“价格不清楚。”我说，“赖永昌自己开价，无论什么价码，我都当然不接受了啊！因为他开的价码，谁知道你银行接受不？你银行不接受，但钱你照收了去，到时候怎么过户给我？而你银行开价，我要看什么样的形式啊！最主要的一点，怎么过户？然后后续的那些麻烦事，潜在的那种啊，我怎么才能万花丛中片瓣不沾？无论哪种，谁都怕钱付不出去了，产权还没有搞好。那就没有必要了。我留着钱吃利息差不好？何必过这趟浑水？有没有好的方法？我不是那种只想我得益不管别人死活的的人。最好就三赢咯！我能满意的价格，银行能收回可接受的贷款比例，赖永昌愿意放手而且没有死了或者留后手的行径。”
“行径？”谢瑜笑了出来，“你用这个词？”
“他怎么贷款，贷的款用到哪里去，你当然清楚了不是？”我说，“不过你是一定要从工作的角度来对待这件事！换位思考，如果我是赖永昌，我在以前用这个项目贷款，然后挪用到其他项目上去，那么这笔贷款一定是溢了价的，假设这笔贷款在其他项目上他赚了钱，那么就算是成功了的；他肯定在想，如果当初这笔贷款放在铜钱岭，那么就可能死翘翘了。所以，基于这样的想法，不投钱在这个项目的话，就算是骗贷了不是？当然了，这笔贷款以前就能这么搞出来，现在当然不行了啊！所以，他多少都投了钱回来铜钱岭，就是想博一下，没想到遇上我这个不按常理出牌的对手，当然就有点发懵了啊！也是基于这一点，或者说，你银行这里其实也知道他回投了多少钱在铜钱岭，所以才没有真正起诉他，如果他投的钱不是在所贷的款的比例的多少是刚好在你银行能容忍的红线之上，你们会请他回来？！”
content_en:
When we got to the dam and got off the car at the Blue Hut, I said, "Let's take a rest!"
"Look!" The bespectacled woman looked at the looming cabin in the woods next to the blue cabin. "There seems to be someone there! How about we go take a look?" This was really a serious inspection.
"Let's go!" I said, "Brother Longfeng, didn't you bring them here today?"
"Hey, it's just a quick show!" Brother Longfeng said, "Actually, what's so interesting about this?"
"Look, look!" Xie Yu was not rude and walked over directly. "Look at this guest. He came to the resort and he didn't forget to work. He can type very fast with his laptop!"
I laughed: "That's our programmer! Su Yuanri, we all call him New Year's Day!" Then I whispered to Xie Yu, "This guy is attracted by Yuan Datou's niece!"
"You mean Yuan Yuan?"
"Come on, come on, Su Yuan Dan!" I called Su Yuan Ri to come over, "I've seen you, thank you!"
"Thank you?" Su Yuanri said, "Thank you, hello! My name is Su Yuanri, they all call me New Year's Day, Yuan's Day, and I don't know who is so old that they misread the word "日" by a horizontal line and it became New Year's Day! I work here! You think it's strange, don't you think? When I came to the company, Mr. Lin said where he would like to work. I don’t want to work in an office, so I come here! This location satisfies my desire to work in front of green water and green mountains all day long. I just like to be alone when I have nothing to do!”
"Hey, it's really good!" Xie Yu said, "Then go about your business!" She turned to me and said, "You really play like this!"
"why
no? "I said, "Every gang member has his or her own personality, so just let them go!" As long as you get the job done, I'll take care of the rest? Am I not tired? How boring that is! I don’t need to worry about it now. Revolution relies on self-consciousness, and doesn’t it have very good results? "
Xie Yu said, "Hey, let me tell you something!" She leaned over and said, "We'll talk as we walk."
I reacted: "Brother Longfeng, take them there on a small train or on a tandem bicycle! Xie Yu and I will go for a walk."
After they all walked away, Xie Yu and I walked on the dam.
"I talked to Lai Yongchang today." Xie Yu said.
"Is it going well?" I asked.
Xie Yu smiled and said, "It's just a formality. He owes us a loan from the bank. Now it's a big honor to ask him to come back from Hong Kong."
"Face? Who gives it to whom?" I asked.
She looked at me: "Is your ability to understand intentional?"
"Hahaha! Deliberately, deliberately." I asked, "I really want to buy Tongqianling." I secretly admitted that when I said this, I did not estimate Zixuan's position when communicating with her, and in doing so, I do have to take a certain risk. Maybe this risk has actually disappeared with the intervention of the bank. Maybe the risk of private lending has emerged with the intervention of the bank? No one can tell. But I just think, firstly, the location, I really like the feeling of standing in the front row and watching the scenery, and Tongqianling is like this; secondly, I am optimistic about Silver Bay. With our current strength, I am willing to increase my investment in Silver Bay, and want to play a similar monopoly, or a sub-monopoly. Although I still feel a bit absurd, if I tell anyone, except for Old Fatty, Brother Longfeng and Coco, others will definitely think that there is something wrong with my brain. --- This is not surprising.Strange, now everyone is an atheist, but they all want God to favor them. They are all contradictory. When they stand in different positions, they feel that the spear is sharper than the shield at this time, and at the same time they feel that the shield is stronger than the spear.
"Do you have such an idea?" Xie Yu looked at me, "Okay!"
"Hey, we all know ourselves and our enemies." I said, "Just tell me!"
"You have to tell me your source of funds first!" Xie Yu said, "I can't just get a loan here, not to mention that we are old classmates, and we have to follow the rules. The rules are, hello, me, hello, everyone. To my old classmates, I said it so straightforwardly!"
"The price is unclear." I said, "Lai Yongchang made his own price. Of course I wouldn't accept it no matter what the price was! Because who knows whether your bank will accept the price he proposed? Your bank won't accept it, but you just take the money. How will you transfer it to me then? And what kind of form do I want to see when your bank offers a price? The most important thing is, how to transfer the account? Then the subsequent troubles, the potential kind, how can I get through the flowers? No matter what, everyone is afraid that the money will not be paid, and the property rights are not yet settled. Then there is no need to keep the money, why bother to go through this trouble? I am not the kind of person who only wants to benefit from others. It is best to have a price that is acceptable to me and Lai Yongchang is willing to let go or hold back. "
"Behavior?" Xie Yu laughed, "Did you use this word?"
"Of course you know how he borrowed the loan and where the loan was used, right?" I said, "But you must treat this matter from a work perspective! Think about it from his perspective, if I were Lai Yongchang, and I used this project to borrow money and then diverted it to other projects, then This loan must be at a premium. Assuming that he made money from this loan on other projects, it would be considered a success; he must be thinking that if the loan was placed in Tongqianling, it might be dead. Therefore, based on this idea, he did not invest in this project. If so, it’s a fraudulent loan, right? Of course, this loan could be obtained in this way before, but of course it can’t be done now! So, he invested some money and came back to Tongqianling just to win, but he didn’t expect to meet an opponent like me who didn’t play by common sense, so of course he was a little confused! It is also based on this, or that your bank actually knows how much money he invested in Tongqianling, so it did not actually prosecute him. If the proportion of the money he invested was not just above the red line that your bank can tolerate, would you ask him to come back? "
